# A second command should fail if the first command introduced compile errors.
rm F
rm G
-- file.go --
package m

func F() int { return G() }
func G() int { return 1 }
-- stdout --
diff old/file.go new/file.go
--- old/file.go
+++ new/file.go
@@ -1,4 +1 @@
 package m
-
-func F() int { return G() }
-func G() int { return 1 }
